subject: RM_WalkingVenomvine
departures: The whole stand is a long, low wedge, tall at one end and sloping down to ground level at the other, not a round mound or a thicket of arching canes
The tall cane at the tail is black and about as high as a man, not green or brown
The low end is a fringe of thin rust-ochre runners lying flat on the ground, not upright shoots or arching stems
Its height drops steadily from the black cane down to the runners, so the stand has a clear direction rather than looking the same all round
The oldest cane at the far tail end is dying back, so the tall end looks old and withered and the low end looks new
